current_conclusion: The `1000ms` held-key cliff exists under the current helper/browser/statistic, and held key is not complete-keypress-then-wait.
decisive_next_artifact: Exact-spec trigger recheck only after helper, browser, trace-placement, throwaway, or statistic changes.
close_condition: Matched held-key/tap/control rows keep the same qualitative ordering under the unchanged metric.
reopen_or_narrow_condition: A metric-definition trigger removes or reverses the held-key/tap split.

current_conclusion: Persistence timing is an ordering marker near the transition; timer-work-shift wording is rejected.
decisive_next_artifact: Joined task/runtime trace only if the wording expands from ordering marker to work placement.
close_condition: Timer rewrite, marker, and no-op controls keep aligning with the transition while work-shift controls remain negative.
reopen_or_narrow_condition: A joined trace shows callback work, next-key work, and counterfactual placement, or persistence ordering no longer aligns.

current_conclusion: The observed cliff is held-key specific; complete-keypress/tap rows are not interchangeable.
decisive_next_artifact: Representative workload replay only if the claim expands to product typing.
close_condition: Input-mode controls keep tap/keypress-then-wait separate from held-key delay.
reopen_or_narrow_condition: Tap or short-hold controls reproduce the same cliff under matched state and retained-key filtering.

current_conclusion: Runtime checkpoint state remains empirical and unnamed below the current JS/browser tables.
decisive_next_artifact: Passive retained-key sidecar with clock sync, renderer/helper identity, observer-off baseline, and joined runtime fields.

reopen_or_narrow_condition: The sidecar perturbs ordering, fails to join, or no runtime field separates classes.

current_conclusion: CPU/QoS state can modulate absolute latency, but frequency, residency, QoS, cache, and scheduler causes are unnamed.
decisive_next_artifact: Accepted sidecar followed by joined powermetrics or trace counters only if mechanism naming is still needed.
close_condition: Joined counters separate retained classes without changing ordering or counts.
reopen_or_narrow_condition: Counters fail to separate classes, require perturbing observers, or contradict runtime-side evidence.

decisive_next_artifact: Real Performance Tests topology artifact retaining failures, retries, resources, first-key tails, retained rows, run order, and environment metadata.
